full_judgment: 7. Learned Assistant Attorney-Genera] next submits that under the provision of section 5(1)(b) of the ordinance LIV of 1985, the inclusion of the property in the list so published is called the conclusive proof of the fact under section 5(2) of the Ordinance and the same has been vested in the Government with effect from 28-2-1972. The predecessors of Suleman Bhai Jiva Respondent No. 3 having failed to rebut this legal presumption of law and facts by producing and examining themselves as PWs by adducing positive original documentary evidences regarding possession and whereabouts of the original owners at the material time that is, on 28-2-1972, therefore, the impugned judgment and order is liable to be declared to have been passed without lawful authority and is of no legal effect.
